verified_key_information_units.information: The company expanded its public-private partnership (PPP) business through new real estate development agreements signed in 2025 for the Krulli quarter (Tallinn) and Uus-Karlowa quarter (Tartu), alongside continued success in the Noblessner area, enhancing long-term workload stability and diversification.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Statement of the Chairman of the Management Board: 'Alongside the successful real estate development partnership in the Noblessner area of Tallinn, we signed two similar cooperation agreements in 2025 for the development of the Krulli quarter in Tallinn and the Uus-Karlowa quarter in Tartu. details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K6, K7, and K8 are fully represented with supporting sentences covering the core material meaning of revenue/profitability decline, project cycle drivers, residential construction surge, liquidity changes, and order book growth. K3 is missing entirely - there is no mention of Merko's largest-ever contracts for the Rūdninkai defence campus in Lithuania or their future revenue contribution. K4 is missing entirely - there is no reference to new real estate development agreements in Krulli (Tallinn) or Uus-Karlowa (Tartu), nor continued Noblessner success. K5 is missing entirely - there is no mention of strategic investment in Connecto-branded network companies or their contribution to net profit. The summary captures most high-importance information but omits three major strategic developments, resulting in a mixed coverage level.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements logically follow one another without contradictions. The decline in revenue and profits is consistently explained by project completions and market conditions. The geographic revenue shifts, margin changes, and segment performance are all mutually supportive. The cash flow decline is explained by increased inventories and dividends, while the improved equity ratio is logically connected to these factors. There is no unnecessary repetition, and the information is organized to form a clear narrative from top-line performance through to financial position and outlook.
